mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M (parent_id, child_id, amount, cycle_type, payment_day, next_payment_date) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{childId}, #{amount}, #{cycleType}, #{paymentDay}, #{nextPaymentDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, child_id, amount, cycle_type, payment_day, next_payment_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, parent_id, child_id, amount, cycle_type, payment_day, next_payment_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M SET child_id = #{childId}, amount = #{amount}, cycle_type = #{cycleType}, payment_day = #{paymentDay}, next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M SET is_active = #{isActive}, next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M SET next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM T_ALW_SCHEDULE_M WHERE is_active = TRUE AND next_payment_date = #{paymentDate}
